title: The fixed source and exceptional coordinates of projection purity
statement: Retain exactly the existing source coordinate isomorphism, exceptional target coordinate map, its etale-origin invertibility and common intrinsic Hom type from the projection-purity construction. These change only the coefficient, tensor, pullback and exceptional identity presentations. The source isomorphism is fixed by HEq to its literal tensor/root/shift composite; the target map is identity at positive rank and the ordinary exceptional identity followed by the comparison counit at rank zero. No purity equality enters these definitions.

source.place: Existing source and exceptional coordinate declarations, before the intrinsic presentation constructions; extracted verbatim for use by the two model comparison steps.
